When the instruction decoder selects R4 as `reg_src` or `reg_dest`, the execution unit presents its value to the ALU operand network. `openMSP430.execution_unit_0.alu_0.alu_and` is an operand, result, or status-producing intermediate reached while the relevant assignment conditions include `openMSP430.execution_unit_0.src_reg_src_sel`. The candidate and asset are linked by `openMSP430.execution_unit_0.register_file_0.r4 -> openMSP430.execution_unit_0.register_file_0.reg_src -> openMSP430.execution_unit_0.op_src -> openMSP430.execution_unit_0.alu_0.op_src_inv -> openMSP430.execution_unit_0.alu_0.alu_and`. The observation bypasses direct protection of R4; even a one-bit flag leaks a predicate that can be accumulated over chosen operations.
